name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Sand Taupe'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Sand Taupe’ delivers yet another in a long line of neutral colorways that have dominate the silhouette’s many releases since its global debut in 2016. Decorative no-tie laces are integrated into to the breathable Primeknit upper, featuring a patchwork-like pattern and a prominent seam that runs down the length of the vamp. On the lateral side panel, coral fibers are woven into the knit construction above the post-dyed monofilament side stripe for a subtle pop of color. A fully caged Boost midsole provides lightweight cushioning.
